name: ai-interviewer
description: 基于 JD 与经历的中文 AI 面试训练工具（三入口 MVP）——T1-S 静态验收包

scripts.web:serve: npm run build && node dist/src/web/cli.js serve
scripts.web:info: npm run build && node dist/src/web/cli.js info
scripts.t1r:models: npm run build && node dist/src/t1r/run-t1r.js models
scripts.t1r:chain-a: npm run build && node dist/src/t1r/run-t1r.js chain-a
scripts.t1r:chain-b: npm run build && node dist/src/t1r/run-t1r.js chain-b
scripts.t1r:latency: npm run build && node dist/src/t1r/run-t1r.js latency
scripts.t2: npm run build && node dist/src/t2/run.js all
scripts.t2:rules: npm run build && node dist/src/t2/run.js rules:write
scripts.t2:calibration: npm run build && node dist/src/t2/run.js calibration
scripts.t2:representative: npm run build && node dist/src/t2/run.js representative
scripts.t1r:recount: npm run build && node dist/src/t1r/run-t1r.js latency:recount
scripts.t1r:manifest: npm run build && node dist/src/t1r/run-t1r.js manifest:refresh
scripts.t1r:session-config: npm run build && node dist/src/t1r/run-t1r.js session-config
